description:
Final Fantasy VIII follows SeeD mercenary Squall Leonhart against the sorceress
Ultimecia. Guardian Forces, key items, and story rewards are shuffled into the
multiworld; junction what the multiworld gives you and finish the war.

v0.1.0.description:
## Install

1. Archipelago **Launcher** → **Install APWorld** → pick `ff8.apworld` (or copy it into `custom_worlds/`), then restart the Launcher.
2. Optional: drop `ff8_ap_tracker.zip` into PopTracker's `packs/` folder.

Requires Archipelago 0.6.7+ and *Final Fantasy VIII* Steam 2013 (`FF8_EN.exe`). Setup guide: the **Final Fantasy VIII** page on your WebHost, or the [Player Guide](https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/blob/main/docs/player-guide.md).


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/commits/v0.1.0

v0.3.0.description:
## Install

1. Archipelago **Launcher** → **Install APWorld** → pick `ff8.apworld` (or copy it into `custom_worlds/`), then restart the Launcher.
2. Optional: drop `ff8_ap_tracker.zip` into PopTracker's `packs/` folder.
3. Optional: `ff8_visual_tracker.zip` is a map preset for the Archipelago Visual Tracker — see below.

### Visual Tracker (new)

`ff8_visual_tracker.zip` pins every FF8 check on clickable world / extras / GF-ability maps inside the [Archipelago Visual Tracker](https://github.com/Wakamu/Archipelago/releases/latest) client. To use it:

1. Install [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases?q=Tracker) (`tracker.apworld`) and [`visualtracker.apworld`](https://github.com/Wakamu/Archipelago/releases/latest) via **Launcher → Install APWorld**, then restart the Launcher.
2. Copy `ff8_visual_tracker.zip` into the `visual_packs/` folder of your Archipelago install (create it next to `custom_worlds/` if missing). Do **not** unzip it.
3. Launcher → **Visual Tracker**, connect to your server/slot; the FF8 preset is picked up automatically.

Visual Tracker support grew out of a community map layout contributed by **caedesender** (Discord) — thank you!

Requires Archipelago 0.6.7+ and *Final Fantasy VIII* Steam 2013 (`FF8_EN.exe`). Setup guide: the **Final Fantasy VIII** page on your WebHost, or the [Player Guide](https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/blob/main/docs/player-guide.md).


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/compare/v0.2.1...v0.3.0

v0.4.0.description:
> ## ⚠️ Stability note
> v0.4.0 carries the **early-Ragnarok** work (Vehicle Unlocks / Vehicle Gates), which manipulates the game's world map in ways no previous release did. It has been through one live test session, not a full playthrough, so expect rough edges: a ship parked somewhere odd, a spawn that needs one more battle, a save made aboard behaving strangely. Both vehicle options are **off by default**, and the sphere changes are generation-only. **If you want the most stable experience for a long multiworld, use [v0.3.0](https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/releases/tag/v0.3.0)** and report anything you hit on v0.4.0.

## What's new in v0.4.0

- **Story Gates** (new option, default `normal`): the story is split into 18 beats and each beat's checks count as in logic only once you hold a rising ladder of GFs and unlock items. A default seed now opens about 60 checks (all Disc 1) and plays as 8-13 real spheres instead of 220 checks in one plateau. `tight` for about 25, `off` for the old shape.
- **Travel hubs:** the world-map draw points of Centra, Trabia, Esthar, and the islands open with the Ragnarok item *or* the story beat that grants it.
- **Vehicle Unlocks** (experimental, off): the Ragnarok item spawns the ship beside you after a battle or town exit, on any disc, and you keep it for the whole game. The Balamb Garden item was removed (a mobile Garden locks you out of Balamb Garden).
- **Vehicle Gates** (experimental, off): the story's own Ragnarok is parked out at sea until the item arrives.
- New **Staircase** preset; PopTracker pack 0.10.0 mirrors the beats, hubs, and ladder; `tools/sphere_report.py` for measuring sphere shape.

## Install

1. Archipelago **Launcher** → **Install APWorld** → pick `ff8.apworld` (or copy it into `custom_worlds/`), then restart the Launcher.
2. Optional: drop `ff8_ap_tracker.zip` into PopTracker's `packs/` folder.
3. Optional: `ff8_visual_tracker.zip` is a map preset for the [Archipelago Visual Tracker](https://github.com/Wakamu/Archipelago/releases/latest) — see **Visual Tracker** below.

### Visual Tracker

`ff8_visual_tracker.zip` pins every FF8 check on clickable world / extras / GF-ability maps inside the Archipelago Visual Tracker client. To use it:

1. Install [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases?q=Tracker) (`tracker.apworld`) and [`visualtracker.apworld`](https://github.com/Wakamu/Archipelago/releases/latest) via **Launcher → Install APWorld**, then restart the Launcher.
2. Copy `ff8_visual_tracker.zip` into the `visual_packs/` folder of your Archipelago install (create it next to `custom_worlds/` if missing). Do **not** unzip it.
3. Launcher → **Visual Tracker**, connect to your server/slot; the FF8 preset is picked up automatically.

Visual Tracker support grew out of a community map layout contributed by **caedesender** (Discord) — thank you!

Requires Archipelago 0.6.7+ and *Final Fantasy VIII* Steam 2013 (`FF8_EN.exe`). Setup guide: the **Final Fantasy VIII** page on your WebHost, or the [Player Guide](https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/blob/main/docs/player-guide.md).


## What's Changed
* v0.4.0: story-beat sphere gating, travel hubs, early Ragnarok by @wilsonao in https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/pull/1

## New Contributors
* @wilsonao made their first contribution in https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/compare/v0.3.0...v0.4.0

v0.6.0.description:
## Story Keys

FF8 finally has doors. Twenty **"Key: <area>"** items, one per world-map entrance (Balamb, Dollet, Timber, Deling City, Winhill, Trabia Garden, Esthar City, Lunar Gate, the chocobo forests, ...). Without the key the town's entrance simply does not work: you walk onto it, nothing happens, and the client says `Locked: Key: Dollet`. The moment the key lands the door works again, right where you stand. No story faking, no file patching: the client rewrites one word of the table the game consults every step, and puts it back when the key arrives.

- `story_keys: areas` — every key is a real door and the checks inside need it in logic, but the story path is never blocked.
- `story_keys: story` — the doors the main line walks through stay shut too, so advancing the story needs keys other players hold. Balamb and Fire Cavern keys are yours from the start.
- Keys carry their `/ff8warp` destination. New preset **Story Keys** (Staircase + `story_keys: story`).
- Keys never open a town before the story does (early entry works, but town interiors assume the story state, so it stays off).
- Also: the study panel credits both starter GFs when one is precollected (thanks Lexra), and the Jukebox trap picks from five tracks.

Off by default while the feature is new. **Stability note:** v0.5.0 remains the stable release; report anything odd with `/ff8` output and the client log. Tracker pack 0.12.0 shows the keys and mirrors the rules.

## Install

1. Archipelago **Launcher** → **Install APWorld** → pick `ff8.apworld` (or copy it into `custom_worlds/`), then restart the Launcher.
2. Optional: drop `ff8_ap_tracker.zip` into PopTracker's `packs/` folder.
3. Optional: `ff8_visual_tracker.zip` is a map preset for the [Archipelago Visual Tracker](https://github.com/Wakamu/Archipelago/releases/latest) — see **Visual Tracker** below.

### Visual Tracker

`ff8_visual_tracker.zip` pins every FF8 check on clickable world / extras / GF-ability maps inside the Archipelago Visual Tracker client. To use it:

2. Copy `ff8_visual_tracker.zip` into the `visual_packs/` folder of your Archipelago install (create it next to `custom_worlds/` if missing). Do **not** unzip it.
